stem.text: A sign outside a shop is suspended from a rusty horizontal hinge at its top end. The sign hangs in equilibrium at an angle of $25^{\circ}$ to the vertical, as shown.

stem.alt: A thin rectangular sign hanging from a hinge at its top end, tilted from a dashed vertical line. The labels hinge and sign are printed, and the angle 25° is marked between the vertical line and the sign.

stem.text: The sign is a square of side length $52\,\text{cm}$ and uniform thickness. It has a mass of $36\,\text{kg}$.
What is the moment of the weight of the sign about the hinge?
